jobs.title: Airport Security Patrol Officer – Day/Night Shifts
jobs.description:
A municipal organization in San Antonio is seeking a Security Guard responsible for patrol and security work at city facilities. The role involves monitoring entry points, providing public assistance, and reporting on safety conditions. Candidates should have a high school diploma or GED, experience in security work, and a valid Texas driver’s license. Successful applicants must pass TSA clearance, reflecting the position’s importance in maintaining a secure environment. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Salary: USD 36000 - 60000 per year
